old_caption: The video captures a lively dance class taking place in a spacious studio with wooden floors and mirrored walls. The instructor, a man wearing a black sleeveless shirt and colorful shorts, leads the class with energetic movements. He is positioned at the front of the room, facing away from the camera, and his arms are lowered, moving rhythmically as he demonstrates the dance steps. The participants, a mix of men and women dressed in casual workout attire, follow along enthusiastically, mirroring the instructor's arm movements. The mirrored walls reflect the dancers, creating an illusion of more participants and adding depth to the scene. The studio is well-lit, with natural light streaming in through large windows on one side, enhancing the vibrant atmosphere. The overall mood is dynamic and engaging, capturing the essence of a group fitness session.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a lively dance class taking place in a spacious studio with wooden floors and mirrored walls. The instructor, a man wearing a black sleeveless shirt and colorful shorts, leads the class with energetic movements. He is positioned at the front of the room, facing away from the camera, and his arms are raised above his head, signaling the start of a dance routine. As he steps forward, his arms lower to his sides, and he begins to move rhythmically, demonstrating the dance steps. The participants, a mix of men and women dressed in casual workout attire, follow along enthusiastically. They mirror the instructor's movements, raising their arms and stepping side to side. The mirrored walls reflect the dancers, creating an illusion of more participants and adding depth to the scene. The studio is well-lit, with natural light streaming in through large windows on one side, enhancing the vibrant atmosphere. The overall mood is dynamic and engaging, capturing the essence of a group fitness session.
caption: The video captures a Zumba session in a wood-floored studio, its full-height mirrored wall fronted by a ballet barre reflecting the dancer's front and background participants. With his back to the static camera, a man in a black sleeveless shirt, colorful ZUMBA-print shorts and multicolor sneakers marches with his right heel lifted and both arms out to the sides. He draws his arms inward into clenched fists at chest height, then raises them overhead in a wide V while balancing on the left leg with the right foot tucked behind. The arms lower to his sides as he continues stepping, the right foot swinging. His torso rotates toward the right, the right arm lifting with a clenched fist as the legs cross in a pivot. The raised arm transfers to the left, stretched overhead. The right leg extends out to the side in a leaning stance. The left arm and extended leg draw inward, leaving him mid-stride with arms near his sides. Throughout, his reflection mirrors each position while the class members behind the barre shift in small independent movements.
